fact: Cabo Verde inaugurated the Centro de Colecta e de Registos de Dados Policiais at the Polícia Judiciária in Praia, an EU-financed, Interpol-supported SIPAO project to centralise police and criminal data digitally, with extension to other police services and courts only hoped for.
title: Cabo Verde já tem Centro de Colecta de Registos de Dados Policiais
